title: Record delete: the confirm dialog never says the delete is permanent, and the toast says "Record deleted" without naming the record
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed split. Triage on #27520 (6495077487) said: 「Each row is either taken, with its own card where it needs code」. This card is row 10.
Business reason: a record delete cannot be undone. The platform has no recycle bin: `enable.trash` was retired, and its tombstone in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` says soft delete "is parked". Yet the confirm dialog only asks "Are you sure?", and the toast does not say which record went. A user who deletes the wrong row gets no warning before, and no name after, to notice it.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (the console's record delete confirm and toast).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "delete confirm dialog does not say permanent cannot be undone toast Record deleted names record" → 0 hits. **New.**

## What happens (row 10 of #27520, 18.3.0 RC walkthrough at `c4c515ad`)

Admin, desktop, delete a task. The confirm dialog does not say the delete cannot be undone. The toast is a generic `Record deleted`, while the create toast names the record.

## Mechanism (read on `origin/main`, not reproduced here)

- Record page: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` ~L3914 `toast.success(t('detail.deleted', { defaultValue: 'Record deleted' }))`. The confirm copy is `detail.deleteConfirmation` ("Are you sure you want to delete this record?").
- A list row delete has its own confirm, with keys near `en.ts` ~L3980 (`deleteConfirm`, and `deleteConfirmTitle: 'Delete {{label}} "{{name}}"?'`). Measure which confirm and toast each delete entry point (record page header, list row menu, bulk delete) uses.
- Studio's object and field deletes already say "This action cannot be undone" (`en.ts` ~L2065). That is the house wording to reuse.

## Expected

- The confirm says the delete is permanent ("This can't be undone"), on every record-delete entry point that shows a confirm.
- The success toast names the record, the same way the create toast does, e.g. `Task "Website Relaunch" deleted`. A bulk delete keeps its count.
- ⛔ No Undo: there is no restore to undo with.

## Acceptance

- One measured repro on current `main` first: list the delete entry points and the keys each uses.
- Tests: the confirm carries the permanence sentence, and the toast names the record (label and name). Control: the bulk delete toast keeps its count. Include an ablation.
- New copy in all ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs. A new key is `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.

Links back: #27520 (row 10)
